finalText:
**Big but mostly mechanical.** 1291 hits, 94 files.

Only the JS identifiers in `services/` are safe to rename. That is ~1075 hits in 75 files.

| Must not rename | Hits | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `migrations/*.sql` | 61 | Applied history. Editing breaks the down step. |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/` | 20 | Regenerated by `npm run vendor:refresh`. |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` + `WIRE` values in [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) | 6 | Public API contract. Breaks every client. |
| SQL strings in repos, like [services/orders/src/repo/order.js:10](services/orders/src/repo/order.js:10) | 125 lines | Column is still `account_id` in the DB. |

Judgment call: the `account_id` key in [lib/audit.js:9](lib/audit.js:9) may feed log queries.

Next: ask them if the rename is code-only or also a DB migration. That changes the answer a lot.
